notes: All ablation + stress-case results from the SocietyBench paper. Numbers verified against /home/ubuntu/overleaf_69e60208/table/*.tex. Subscripts represent delta vs the in-paper baseline (the row with is_baseline: true).

stress_case.title: Two events, two failure axes
stress_case.subtitle: The largest single-event per-axis spreads in the validated leaderboard. SMCI's +28.2 Cal gap and Trump-Tariff's +44.9 Time gap are the two largest single-event gaps across all five validated LLMs.

events.name: SMCI
events.label: Financial markets — delisting crisis (47-day arc)
events.takeaway: Calibration on short-arc events with company-specific numerical detail is the hardest single axis.

events.name: Trump-Tariff
events.label: Trade policy — reciprocal-tariff escalation (90-day arc)
events.takeaway: Qwen3 collapses to ~half the bucket-midpoint baseline (24.4) on the longest-arc event — only sub-baseline temporal score across the five validated LLMs.

question_bank_composition.title: Question-bank composition
question_bank_composition.subtitle: Drop one question type and re-score on Doubao. Subscripts = inflation vs. the full bank (lower-on-the-table = more difficulty was supplied by that type).
question_bank_composition.takeaway: Removing A-type (time-gradient) inflates calibration the most (+5.8) — it carries the bulk of the bank's difficulty. D-type adds another +4.2.

scoring_formula.title: Calibration scoring formula
scoring_formula.subtitle: Re-score the same model answers under five aggregation rules. The Doubao–Gemini gap is stable across rules — ranking is robust to the formula choice.
scoring_formula.takeaway: Doubao–Gemini gap clusters tightly between 8.5–9.6 across all rules — the model ordering survives the formula choice.

reasoning_depth.title: Reasoning-depth budget
reasoning_depth.subtitle: Gemini-3.1-pro at three thinking-effort levels. Subscripts = gap to our high-budget setting.
reasoning_depth.takeaway: Calibration scales steeply with depth (25.4 → 30.8 → 33.6). Reporting frontier models at lower budgets would understate calibration by 5–8 points.

anonymization_protocol.title: Anonymization protocol
anonymization_protocol.subtitle: Per-event Cal on Doubao with each anonymization stage disabled. Both stages are load-bearing.
anonymization_protocol.takeaway: Disabling both stages inflates cross-event mean by +4.5. US-Iran (+6.4) and Wuhan (+5.2) leak most — distinctive named entities.
